findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new logger, so logs written through it are never recorded.
findings.body: `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now logs with `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. With a `TestLogger`, that call goes to a new `NewTestLogger()` instance, so the `InfoLogs.Calls`, `Message` and `Ctx` fields on the logger the test passed in never change. Tests that check what a middleware logged will see zero calls, and passing tests can no longer show the logging works. Return the receiver instead (`return f`) so calls made through the contextual logger are still recorded.
